subject: Renewal orchestration kickoff — playbook, stakeholder matrix & QBR windowing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Devon Lane <devon@lumenhealth.com>, procurement@lumenhealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal orchestration kickoff — playbook, stakeholder matrix & QBR windowing

Hi Devon / LumenHealth procurement team,

Thanks for the continued partnership — excited to kick off the renewal conversation for DL-4827. To keep this tight and executable, I attached a short playbook and a proposed amendment we think will cover the primary items (term, committed capacity, and billing cadence).

High-level proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm primary stakeholders + procurement contact
- Week 1: Redwood sends redline-friendly amendment and SOW sketch
- Week 2: procurement Q&A and minor redlines; we surface any technical/ops asks
- Week 3: finalize amendment; align on QBR agenda and metrics

QBR scheduling: we want a 60-minute kickoff QBR to align on usage trends, capacity needs, and uplift options. Proposed windows (please pick 2 that work):
- Tue Jun 15, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 16, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu Jun 17, 08:30–09:30 PT

Action items for LumenHealth: please confirm 1) primary commercial contact for redlines, 2) technical lead for capacity sizing, and 3) a preferred QBR window.

Attachments: Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (playbook + recommended canary for uplift), Suggested_Amendment_LumenHealth.docx (editable). I also attached a quick stakeholder list template (Lumen_Stakeholder_List.csv) — feel free to update and send back.

If it helps, we can run a short pre-QBR sync (30m) with your SRE/ML infra folks to review usage telemetry and burst profiles.

Thanks — looking forward to your availability.

—
Jonas Weber
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference
From: Devon Lane <devon@lumenhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal orchestration kickoff — playbook, stakeholder matrix & QBR windowing

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear plan and the docs.

We can take Wed Jun 16, 13:00–14:00 PT for the QBR. I've looped in procurement and attached our internal stakeholder list (updated). Procurement will likely push a couple of standard data-protection clauses and a shorter billing ramp.

Quick answers to your action items:
1) Commercial contact (for redlines): Devon Lane (me)
2) Technical lead: Priya Natarajan (SRE lead) — priya.n@lumenhealth.com
3) QBR window: Wed Jun 16, 13:00–14:00 PT

We also want to understand the uplift runway: if we commit to a stepped capacity increase, what are the typical lead times for Dedicated vs Hosted capacity? Can you include a short note in the playbook about expected provisioning timelines?

Thanks — I'll expect the editable amendment and will route to procurement for early review.

—
Devon Lane
Director, Platform Engineering
LumenHealth
devon@lumenhealth.com | (206) 555-0199
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Devon Lane <devon@lumenhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal orchestration kickoff — playbook, stakeholder matrix & QBR windowing

Devon — great, thanks for the quick reply and for adding Priya. We'll include provisioning lead times and a short runbook for stepped capacity in the playbook. Quick notes from our side: 

- Dedicated capacity: typical procurement-to-provision window is ~10 business days once billing is finalized; burst pools can be enabled sooner (2–3 business days) depending on region.
- Hosted autoscale: immediate up to configured soft limits; for guaranteed throughput we recommend a committed pool.

Next steps (Redwood):
1) I'll drop an amendment with a tracked-change view before EOD PT (Suggested_Amendment_LumenHealth.docx — updated with procurement-friendly language).
2) Soojin will add a provisioning timeline appendix to the playbook and send a short FAQ for procurement.
3) Jonas to send calendar invite for Jun 16 QBR and include Priya and procurement.

Jonas / Soojin: please make sure we have an ops pre-sync with Priya (30m) the week prior if possible — suggests Tue Jun 8 or Thu Jun 10. Priya, can you confirm availability?

—
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0234

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-4827) and DocuSign preparation page (https://www.docusign.com/prepare/DL-4827-amendment).
